_readme: This is the resume test bank for AI Career Copilot. Each entry is one resume. To add a real resume later: copy the block structure of any entry below, give it a new unique 'id', paste the resume text into 'raw_text' (keep original formatting/line breaks as-is — the parser is supposed to handle messy real-world text), and set 'source' to 'real'. Nothing else needs to change; the app reads this whole array.
